market_definition: The India Potassium Sorbate Market covers sales of potassium sorbate (e202) (granular, powder and solution grades, food, beverage, cosmetic, pharmaceutical and feed grade preservative) used in food and beverages (bakery, dairy, cheese, wine, juices, sauces), cosmetics and personal care, pharmaceuticals and animal feed. GEOGRAPHY: India - companies headquartered in India. COMPANY TYPE IN THIS LIST - DISTRIBUTOR / WHOLESALER: a distributor, wholesaler, trader, importer or stockist that buys potassium sorbate from its producers and resells it to food, beverage, pharmaceutical, cosmetic and feed manufacturers. EXCLUDED: potassium sorbate producers and their own sales subsidiaries, and companies selling only finished consumer products.
who_is_included: DISTRIBUTOR DEFINITION (physical goods market): a company whose PRIMARY business is buying in volume from manufacturers and reselling/distributing onward - wholesale, authorized, value-added or stocking distributor. EXCLUDED: channel partners, resellers, VARs, dealers, agents and brokers that do not stock or wholesale; manufacturers and OEMs (including a manufacturer's own sales subsidiary); system integrators; and pure service providers or consultancies. Continent / Geography = countries with a physical site (HQ, office, warehouse, plant). Operational Presence = every country the company does business in, which is WIDER. Blank or NPD in a contact column means no published evidence was found - it is never a guess.
